===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-penalty kick.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q279532}}{{lb|en|soccer}} A form of [[direct free kick]], taken from the [[penalty spot]] after a defensive foul in the [[penalty box]], with only the [[goalkeeper]] defending the [[goal]].
# {{lb|en|rugby}} A form of free kick in which the [[ball]] may be kicked towards [[touch]], towards the [[goal]] or [[dribbled]].
